entities.summary: Ludvig Rensfeldt is a Swedish ice hockey player, currently playing with Djurgårdens IF in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He was drafted in the second round, 35th overall by the Chicago Blackhawks as the first Swedish player selected in the 2010 NHL Entry Draft.
